_comment: Anti-thrash ledger for the GSC auto-fix loop. Dedup key is (url, issueType). Entries stay forever as history. status: fixed_pending_recrawl (fix deployed, waiting 2-6 weeks for Google recrawl - do NOT re-fix while the live check passes), escalated (fix live > 30 days but GSC still reports it - a GitHub issue was opened, no more code edits), failed (fix attempt reverted after validation or verify failure). Copy to ./seo-autofix-ledger.json and pass via --ledger.
